# fjordrun_shared_variables (Resource)

An environment's shared variables, which services reference as `${{shared.VAR}}`. With `auto_deploy = true`, a change redeploys the running services that reference a changed variable.

**References and generated values.** Values may contain `${{Service.VAR}}`, `${{shared.VAR}}` and `${{secret(32)}}`. The state holds what you wrote, not what it resolves to, so a changing reference is no diff. A `${{secret(N)}}` generator is expanded once, when the variable is first written; it stays as written in the configuration and state, and later applies keep the generated value. Read resolved values with the `fjordrun_service_variables` or `fjordrun_shared_variables` data source.

**Exclusive or partial.** With `exclusive = true` (the default) this resource owns all the variables: others, set elsewhere, are removed. With `exclusive = false` it only manages the keys in `variables`, which is what you want on services that came from a template, whose variables include generated passwords.

~> Values are sensitive and kept in Terraform state: use an encrypted remote state backend.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_shared_variables" "production" {
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id

  variables = {
    APP_ENV = "production"
    API_KEY = "$${{secret(32)}}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Variables by name. Names look like `MY_VAR`.

### Optional

- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Deploy when this resource is created or changes. Leave out to use the provider's `auto_deploy` (default `false`: the change is saved and goes live with the next deployment, which `fjordrun_deployment` makes explicit, so an apply with several changes to a service makes one deployment).
- `exclusive` (Boolean) Whether this resource owns all the variables (default), or only the keys in `variables`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The environment ID.
- `variables_hash` (String, Sensitive) Digest of `variables`, for `fjordrun_deployment` triggers. Sensitive, because it is derived from secret values.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by environment ID
terraform import fjordrun_shared_variables.production 66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
